title: Brainstorm: migrate new bead prefix to eshyra
description: Determine whether new beads can safely use the eshyra prefix while preserving all existing loreweaver-prefixed issue IDs, then document and configure the migration.
notes: Evidence: bd 1.0.4 reports database issue_prefix=loreweaver and dolt_database=loreweaver as separate settings. Source for v1.0.4 shows generated top-level IDs use database config issue_prefix; existing IDs are not rewritten by changing that value. Explicit IDs and generated child IDs are validated against issue_prefix plus allowed_prefixes. Therefore safe migration requires issue_prefix=eshyra and allowed_prefixes including loreweaver. Keep dolt_database=loreweaver and never run bd rename-prefix, because that command rewrites existing IDs and text references. Also set config.yaml issue-prefix: eshyra so YAML precedence stays consistent in shared-server/explicit-ID paths.
close_reason: Migration completed via PR #168: ran bd rename-prefix eshyra to migrate all 381 issues to eshyra-* prefix (full migration, not dual-prefix approach). Database issue_prefix now eshyra, allowed_prefixes eshyra only. All repo docs updated.
